5 Minutes Shrimp Curry
By: MIguel Picciochi
Published: Tuesday, April 5, 2011 - 7:04am

Ingredients




500 grams peeled shrimp 20/30
2 green apples
2 courgette
100 grams curry powder
250 fresh cream
80 grams butter
salt

Preparation

1 Caramelize apples and courgettes in butter, after golden join shrimp, after shrimp is pink put curry powder, stir and let cook about 2 minutes, pour fresh cream stir for one minute grinding salt and its ready to serve. 2 Serve with white rice.
